ideas.pitch: An intelligent conference agenda planner and live Q&A summarizer that uses semantic routing to instantly categorize, route, and answer attendee questions during live tech conferences.
ideas.title: ConfSync AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core themes of the hackathon focusing on both Software Development and Conferences by solving real-time event engagement challenges.

ideas.pitch: A visual BPMN-orchestrated platform designed for conference organizers to automate speaker scheduling, submission reviews, and human-in-the-loop risk management for session tracks.
ideas.title: BPMN DevConf Workflow Manager
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes complex workflow orchestration which satisfies the expectation for genuinely hard software engineering within a 36-hour timeframe.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous data lineage and incident response tool tailored for large-scale conference streaming data and registration pipelines, featuring automated evidence gating and pull request generation.
ideas.title: DataHub Conference Metrics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates advanced data engineering capabilities that stand out among typical frontend-heavy hackathon submissions.

ideas.pitch: An offline-capable AI code reviewer and presentation analyzer that runs locally on hardware to evaluate conference paper submissions and software source code for technical feasibility.
ideas.title: Agentic ConfReviewer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines software development evaluation with conference submission workflows, directly fitting the primary twin pillars of Tech Eximius 2.0.

ideas.pitch: A federated Model Context Protocol server platform that securely connects distributed medical conference databases for live collaborative clinical AI agent demonstrations.
ideas.title: MCP Clinical Conf Net
